product_metadata.title: CAVN Stroller Fan Clip on, Max 45 Hours Oscillating Fan, 5000mAh Rechargeable Battery Portable Personal Small Fan for Baby Stroller Crib Bedroom Car Office Outdoor
features: [Auto Oscillation & 360 Degree Rotation] This oscillating fan is designed with auto oscillation of 60 degree - 80 degree as well as 350 degree vertical and horizontal rotation.
[5000 mAh Built-in Battery & Max about 45 Hours] This small desk portable fan can be powered by Rechargeable Battery or USB. It provides up to 5 to 45 hours according to the speeding setting.
[Portable Fan with Stepless Speed Control ] This stroller fan is designed in portable size and you can adjust the most comfortable wind speed with its stepless speed control button.
[Multi-use Oscillating Fan] This oscillating fan can be used as stroller fan, car fan, desktop table standing fan, clip fan, bed fan and so on.
Package Including 1 pack stroller fan clip on, 2 pcs sponges, 1 pc usb cable and user manual.
